title: The botting situation is out of control

posts.cooked:
There are so many mage bots doing the same things over and over again. When i see them i bring a whole bunch of mobs to them, and they frost nova, and coc, getting all the aggro and dying.

We need AI to sort these bots out. If a player reports someone botting, AI will immediately do a review of the last 30 fights that player was in, then maybe a temp ban with a gm review if the AI suspects botting.

I followed one to booty bay and it would immediately attack my totems placed down causing guard aggro.

Here is the bot rotation upon spawning from a death.

  1. Conjure food/water and eat/drink to full.
  2. Conjure mana agate
  3. Drink to full.
  4. Cast fireball or frostbolt.
  5. Mob comes a couple feet to it, frost nova.
  6. If 2 or 3 mobs, will cone of cold, or attempt to sheep one.
  7. If attacked with spells instantly counterspell that mob or player.

If any hostile mobs get close it to it, it will immediately frost nova, and cone of cold, even if those mobs are attacking a member of the enemy faction. Something needs to be done I killed 30 alliance mage bots in stv today. thirty.
